internal.title: Incident Report: Cart Service Elevated Error Rate Due to Injected Errors
internal.body:
At 10:14 UTC on 2026-11-08, an alert was triggered for a high error rate in the cart service. Investigation identified that the error rate increased to 12% shortly after the cartFailure flag was set to 10%. Error spans indicated 'Valkey connection error', confirming injected errors in the cart service. Dependency issues with valkey-cart service were also observed but were secondary. 

The mitigation involved disabling the cartFailure flag at 10:34 UTC, which led to a rapid recovery with error rates dropping to normal levels (0.2%). The incident was resolved shortly after the flag was disabled.

Timeline:
- 10:14:58: Alert received for high error rate in cart
- 10:34:43: Diagnosis confirmed error injection due to cartFailure flag
- 10:34:49: Flag disabled after approval
- 10:34:49: Recovery verified with normalized error rates

Root cause: Injected errors caused by the cartFailure flag change.

Resolution: Disabled the cartFailure flag to stop error injection and restore service stability.

external.title: Some customers experienced issues adding items to cart
external.body: Between 10:14 and 10:34 UTC on 2026-11-08, some customers experienced errors when adding items to their shopping cart. This was due to an internal issue causing elevated error rates in the cart service. The issue was identified and resolved by disabling the problematic configuration, restoring normal service operation. We apologize for any inconvenience caused.
